thread.title: Dow falls nearly 300 points at lows, threatens to give up weekly gain in late trade - MarketWatch

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Dow falls nearly 300 points at lows, threatens to give up weekly gain in late trade - MarketWatch
text: The Dow Jones Industrial Average on Friday was encountering intensifying selling pressure with less than an hour left of trading, with the blue chip gauge on the verge of giving up its weekly gain. Part of the blame for the downdraft accelerating was a rise of the yield in the benchmark 10-year Treasury note TMUBMUSD10Y, +1.57% to 2.96%, representing the highest since around 2014. Meanwhile, shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, -4.10% were powering the decline, cutting about 50 points from the average. Most recently, the Dow DJIA, -0.82% was down about 256 points, or 1%, with the benchmark hanging on to a weekly advance of about 0.2%. Apple's stock, off $7, or 4%, also was dragging the broader technology sector lower, with Dow component International Business Machines Corp. share [: IBM] slicing about 20 points from the average. The tech-laden Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, -1.27% was taking the brunt of the intraday tumble among the main benchmarks, off 1.4%, at 7,138. The S&P 500 index SPX, -0.85% was down 1% at 2,666, with tech XLK, -1.39% and the consumer-staples sectors XLP, -1.67% both off nearly 2%, leading losses in the broad-market index. The S&P 500 was holding on to a weekly gain of 0.4%, while the Nasdaq boasts a rise over the 5-session period of 0.5%.
